sources.name: NTP/EPA Phase-1 DNT MEA Network Formation
Brown et al. MEA developmental neurotoxicity screening
Vassallo et al. multi-laboratory acute neural MEA
sources.compatibility: excluded from sequential replay: the public processed workbook contains baseline summaries but not phase-resolved dose responses; the raw timestamp archive does not retain a validated phase-to-dose map

compatibility_note: Only longitudinal neural MEA datasets with dose, DIV and well-level mean firing rate were pooled or compared. The Vassallo archive was audited but excluded because its public processed files do not expose a compatible phase-resolved sequential response grid. No organ-on-chip dataset was merged because no public candidate found in the search exposed a compatible repeated dose-by-time electrophysiology grid and measurement-cost contract.
